sentences: I understand you're new to the industry, so I'll be blunt and clear with my expectations.
Now, when working remotely, never use a VPN.
It's important for security reasons, and we have other measures in place to ensure secure connections.
End all attribute names with '_j' and start all method names with 'a_'.
This is to maintain consistency within the team.
Consistency is key in software development, and it's important that your code aligns with the team's standards.
For now, I want you to familiarize yourself with our code base and documentation.
Initiative and independence are important traits for a software engineer.
These benefits are in place precisely to support you, and there should be no stigma attached to utilizing them.
These benefits are an important part of your overall compensation package, and I encourage you to utilize them whenever necessary.
Don't hesitate to reach out if you have any further questions or concerns.
Pablo, I want you to stop using notebooks for note-taking.
It's a bad habit, and it will hinder your ability to code efficiently.
From now on, use a plain text editor.
When naming attributes, end them with '_at'.
This is to maintain consistency with our current codebase.
Also, remember to add the '@count_calls' decorator from the 'pedantic' module to all your functions.
It's an important tool for debugging and performance analysis.
